items.title: 18.7.1 Copper(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ligand exchange reactions of copper(II) (PDF 28).

blocks.text: Cu2+(aq) ka asal matlab complex ion [Cu(H2O)6]2+ hai, jo copper(II) ke namkon ke mehlool, jaise copper sulphate ke mehlool, ko neela rang deta hai.

blocks.caption: Copper(II) ke ligand exchange reactions
rows: neele mehlool se halka neela precipitate; do OH- do H2O ki jagah
precipitate ghul kar gehra neela mehlool
neele se gehra neela; chaar NH3 chaar H2O ki jagah

blocks.alt: Square brackets mein [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+: beech mein Cu, chaar NH3 aik dashed square plane ke konon par (aage ke do wedge bonds par, peechhe ke do dashed bonds par), aur aik H2O plane ke oopar aur aik neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+(aq) ion ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Aasan formula
blocks.text: [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ ko aksar sirf [Cu(NH3)4]2+ likha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen flasks. Beech wala ('Start here'): neela [Cu(H2O)6]2+, paani ke saath mashhoor neela Cu2+ complex. Baen, conc. HCl ki botal ke saath: peela-hara [CuCl4]2-, jo conc. HCl daalne se banta hai. Daen, conc. NH3 ki botal ke saath: gehra neela [Cu(H2O)2(NH3)4]2+, jo conc. NH3 daalne se banta hai. Flasks ke darmiyan equilibrium ke teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.8: Ligand exchange reaction ke natije mein rang ki tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech ke neele flask se shuru karein. Conc. HCl daalne se chaar Cl- chhe H2O ki jagah lete hain aur tetrahedral peela-hara [CuCl4]2- banta hai; conc. NH3 daalne se chaar NH3 chaar H2O ki jagah lete hain aur gehra neela octahedral complex banta hai. Teer dono taraf hain kyunke yeh equilibrium hain: zyada paani daalne se reaction wapas jata hai. NaOH se halka neela precipitate [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] banta hai jo zaid ammonia mein ghul jata hai; kitab is ka figure nahi deti.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.8 ki ibarat mein 'This is yellow-green complex forms' chhapa hai; durust angrezi 'This yellow-green complex forms' hai (yeh peela-hara complex banta hai).

blocks.prompt: Copper(II) mehlool mein zaid ammonia milane par gehra neela rang kaun sa complex ion deta hai?

items: NH3 se gehra neela [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+; conc. HCl se peela-hara [CuCl4]2-.
